facts.fact: 相恋七天的纪念日——她第一次觉得起床是件值得期待的事。
她的清醒一瞬：这个男人手握她的心，随时能把她彻底毁掉。
facts.anchor: it’s terrifyingly that this one man has my heart in the palm of his hand and could destroy me for good at any given moment.

facts.fact: 她的过去：一夜情后她比对方更急着让对方消失——好假装道德没掉得比裤子快。
facts.anchor: I was always just as eager for most of them to vanish into thin air so I could pretend I hadn’t dropped my morals as quick as my pants.

facts.fact: 晨间发现他不在床边她瞬间恐慌：他出门前一定会吻她的，绝不会忘。
facts.anchor: He always gives me a kiss before he leaves for work. There’s no way he would forget that.

facts.fact: 相识第七天他开口：「要不你搬来跟我住？」
facts.anchor: ‘Cas, what if you moved in with me?’

facts.fact: 他的理由藏着一根刺：「反正你也等于搬进来了」。
facts.anchor: You’ve practically moved yourself in already.

facts.fact: 她想确认关系，他大笑：我们不是中学生——「我们和别人不一样」，不需要 label。
facts.anchor: there wasn’t a need for a stupid chat about labels because me and you, we’re different from everyone else.

facts.fact: 他的条件：别再搞你那套「creepy witchy shit」——从现在起我养你。
facts.anchor: you won’t even have to do your creepy witchy shit anymore. I’ll take care of you now.
